title: Send photos, videos or a file
summary: Shows what the user picked before it goes out, with an optional caption. Send uploads each item through the SDK send queue, end-to-end encrypted.

localUrl.description: The local file of the item.

kind.description: From the picker and the file's media type.

fileName.description: The file name, shown for a file.

tooLarge.description: size is above Client.getMaxMediaUploadSize: bipe_app_attach_too_large, and the item cannot be sent.

items.description: In the order picked. Up to the system picker's limit.

caption.description: The caption as typed. Goes with the first item only.

maxUploadSize.description: Client.getMaxMediaUploadSize, formatted by the platform for bipe_app_attach_too_large.

sending.description: true while the items go to the send queue.

appear.effect: Reads Client.getMaxMediaUploadSize and marks items over it.

remove.effect: Takes the item out. With no item left, closes the screen.

send.effect: For each item that is not tooLarge: Timeline.sendAttachment with UploadParameters (source the file, caption for the first item) and AttachmentKind image (ImageInfo, a thumbnail), video (VideoInfo, a thumbnail) or file (FileInfo). Then closes; the items show in the timeline with their upload state. A failed send shows bipe_app_attach_failed on the item in the timeline, with retry.

notes: In an encrypted room the SDK encrypts every upload on the device, so the media server stores only ciphertext.

Image and video: the app makes the thumbnail and reads width, height, duration and blurhash on the device before the send. Photos and videos follow the quality the user chose in Conversas e mídia (settings-group chats, mediaQuality).
A caption on an image or video is a normal Matrix caption (MSC2530). Captions on voice messages are reserved for the transcript (ADR 0023), so voice-recording never offers one.
Several photos go as one message each, in order. A Matrix gallery event (Timeline.sendGallery) is out of scope until other clients show it.
Viewer, saving and forwarding of media are the media issue (bipe-chat/bipe#561).
